answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments bind each agent to a sequential zero-knowledge verifiable delay, making identity cloning infeasible. A zephyr beacon supplies randomness, an ember commitment anchors the delay proof, and a lantern verifier finalizes state without revealing witnesses.
